(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターダイヤモンド&パール''' ''Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} series created by 坂井 孝行 Sakai Takayuki. It is based on ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', and the stories feature {{Ash}} and {{an|Dawn}}'s adventures. Unlike other manga adaptations of {{aniseries|PTS}}, Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl features original stories rather than adaptations of the plotlines of specific episodes.
